tests/data/static-preview-translations/oqg-static-preview-texts.data.ts

Bundled source snapshot. Credential-like literals are omitted. Line numbers correspond to the audited repository file; this page is for reading and is not executable test code.

1 /**
2  * AUTO-GENERATED FILE — do not edit by hand.
3  *
4  * Source: oqg-preview-string-sources.ts
5  * Generator: scripts/generate-oqg-static-preview-texts.mjs
6  * Locales: /home/oshada/Documents/Rightmo/QR/qr-web-frontend/src/locales

8  * Shape:
9  *   qrType → {
10  *     shared:       { [text]: count }
11  *     locales:      { [locale]: { [text]: count } }   // exact getByText
12  *     contains:     { [locale]: { [text]: count } }   // toContainText only
13  *     exactlyOneOf: { [locale]: [ [textA, textB], ... ] }
14  *   }
15  *
16  * Use helpers from ./index.ts
17  */

84 /** Visible text → expected occurrence count inside the phone-mockup preview. */
85 export type OqgPreviewTextCounts = Readonly<Record<string, number>>
86 
87 export interface OqgStaticPreviewTextEntry {
88     /** Hardcoded demo strings identical in every locale */
89     readonly shared: OqgPreviewTextCounts
90     /** Resolved translation values per locale (exact-match friendly) */
91     readonly locales: Readonly<Record<OqgLocale, OqgPreviewTextCounts>>
92     /**
93      * Strings that appear inside a longer text node (e.g. "Open hours - Open now").
94      * Assert with toContainText / substring count — not exact getByText.
95      */
96     readonly contains: Readonly<Record<OqgLocale, OqgPreviewTextCounts>>
97     /**
98      * Pairs of mutually exclusive strings (e.g. Open now / Closed).
99      * After WeekHours hydration, exactly one string from each pair is visible.
100      */
101     readonly exactlyOneOf: Readonly<
102         Record<OqgLocale, readonly (readonly [string, string])[]>
103     >
104 }
105
